features.name: log_capital_run_total
features.description: Log-transformed total length of uninterrupted sequences of capital letters.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes the scale of capital run length total, reducing the impact of extreme outliers on Euclidean distance calculations.

features.name: capital_run_density
features.description: Ratio of total capital run length to the longest capital run length.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the distribution of capital letters, providing a scale-invariant structural feature that improves neighborhood geometry.

features.name: total_char_freq_symbols
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates symbol frequencies to create a dense, scale-comparable feature for distance calculation.
features.formula: char_freq_0 + char_freq_1 + char_freq_2 + char_freq_3 + char_freq_4 + char_freq_5

features.name: high_variance_word_intensity
features.description: Log-transformed sum of selected high-variance word frequencies.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups high-variance word frequencies into a single normalized dimension, reducing noise in distance metrics.

features.name: is_high_capital_run
features.description: Binary indicator for whether the average capital run length exceeds 5.0.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a binary indicator for clustering, partitioning the space into high and low capitalization regions.

features.name: word_freq_dominance
features.description: The maximum frequency among a subset of highly variable words.
features.expected_model_benefit: Extracts the maximum frequency among highly variable words, acting as a prototype-like feature for extreme values.

features.name: char_freq_3_normalized
features.description: Clipped and scaled version of char_freq_3.
features.expected_model_benefit: Bounds and scales a highly skewed character frequency, preventing it from dominating the distance metric.

features.name: capital_run_longest_to_total_ratio
features.description: Ratio of the longest capital run to the total capital run length.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a bounded [0,1] ratio representing the concentration of capital letters in a single run, ideal for KNN.

features.name: semantic_urgency_score
features.description: A semantic assessment of the text's urgency or call-to-action intensity, based on the combination of word frequencies and exclamation/symbol usage.
features.expected_model_benefit: Embeds complex semantic meaning into a single continuous dimension, enriching the neighborhood geometry.

features.name: structural_complexity_index
features.description: An evaluation of the document's structural complexity, considering the interplay between average capital run lengths, total length, and symbol diversity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic structural metric that helps KNN distinguish between simple and complex document layouts.

features.name: prototype_distance_origin
features.description: L2 norm of the first five word frequencies, representing distance from the origin in a specific subspace.
features.expected_model_benefit: Computes the L2 norm of a subset of features, acting as an unsupervised distance to the origin to help structure the space.

features.name: symbol_to_word_ratio
features.description: Ratio of total symbol frequencies to the sum of the first five word frequencies.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the relative density of symbols to common words, offering a scale-invariant ratio for similarity search.
features.formula: (char_freq_0 + char_freq_1 + char_freq_2 + char_freq_3 + char_freq_4 + char_freq_5) / np.maximum(word_freq_0 + word_freq_1 + word_freq_2 + word_freq_3 + word_freq_4, 0.1)
